title: Adoption Contract — draft 0.1.0
description: Piece 2 of the growth layer: the control gate that makes a decision effective. An adoption request carries the piece-0 identity (three-layer), the P5 versions, the payload digest, and the grants in effect at the decision point (for the dispatch-time authority recheck, 14-A4). The state machine (go/internal/adopt) is the single winner: first request under a key adopts; a same-key same-digest retry reuses; a same-key different-digest request is rejected (15 B4 / 14-A5 counterexample four). State machine states: adopted → dispatched | unresolved (timeout / crash at the dispatch boundary, first-class per 14-A5 counterexample three) → completed/failed — the machine has no acquire state; the adoption event is the entry point. Provenance: NGA overall-design P3/§7, 14-A5, 15-B4 — all 'proposed', this schema is an evidence-track probe answer.

versions.description: P5 five-dimension version binding (what the decision actually consumed).

payload_digest.description: sha256 hex of JCS(request payload). The idempotency key is operation_id + payload_digest; a changed payload under the same key is a rejection.

grants_at_decision.description: The caller's grant set pinned at the decision point — the dispatch-time authority recheck (14-A4: initial admission guarantees nothing about later permission) compares the live grant set against this snapshot.

accountability.description: Festival D31 triple riding the same event (join point with the ledger).
